propositions: Pause and resume operations must preserve backward compatibility with old readers while maintaining dual-format blob state including gated_mode reconcile-check and pause metadata fields
Pause operation must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and return rc 0 with exact anchored JSON BRIDGE_PAUSED marker that workflow uses to skip commit-and-push

Pause metadata must enforce repository git user.email identity and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp, rejecting blank reason missing identity missing remote different reason and CAS conflicts without overwrite
Resume operation must be CAS-safe on observed ref OID and cleanly recover corrupt blob state without traceback while returning rc 1 for corruption
Scheduled workflow must recognize only complete rc 0 BRIDGE_PAUSED marker for pause behavior while preserving legacy gate rc 4 reconcile-check early return and old rebar reconcile mode vocabulary
All legacy exit codes benign rc 0 malformed markers corrupt rc 1 and legacy gate rc 4 behavior must remain functionally unchanged for existing workflow and environment behavior
